TH Köln Thesis Template (Quarto)

For Bachelor's and Master's theses supervised by Stavros Kousidis.

The thesis is written in Markdown and typeset with LaTeX in the layout of the official TH Köln thesis template. The PDF below is the template itself: it explains how to write, cite and include computations.

Open the preview (PDF) Template repository
  • Cover page, declaration and lists generated from one configuration file, for theses written in English
  • Numbered, cross-referenced equations, figures, tables, theorems, definitions and algorithms
  • biblatex citations, optional CryptoBib for cryptography papers
  • Optional Python in marimo cells: figures and tables computed from your data
  • Every push to your repository renders the PDF on GitHub
Independently maintained adaptation of the TH Köln LaTeX thesis template, not an official TH Köln publication.
